messages.content: Write the About page for a company that makes scheduling software for medical clinics. Around 250 words.

output:
It passes the lint. Here's the About page:

---

**About Meridian Scheduling**

Clinics run on appointments, and most scheduling software wasn't built by anyone who ever worked a front desk. We were. Two of our founders spent years managing intake at a multi-provider family practice, juggling no-shows, insurance verification, and a phone that never stopped ringing. The tools they had access to treated scheduling as an afterthought bolted onto a billing system. We started this company to fix that.

Meridian is built specifically for medical clinics: multi-provider calendars, automated reminders that cut no-show rates, real-time eligibility checks, and a patient booking portal that doesn't require a phone call. It connects to the major EHR systems clinics already use, so staff don't have to enter the same patient information twice.

We work with independent practices, multi-location clinic groups, and specialty providers across dermatology, physical therapy, dental, and behavioral health. Each of these has different scheduling needs — a PT clinic books recurring sessions; a dermatology practice manages procedure rooms and equipment; a behavioral health practice needs longer buffer windows between appointments. Our software adapts to those differences instead of forcing every clinic into the same template.

We're a team of about thirty people, split between engineering and clinical operations, headquartered in Denver with clinics on our platform across the country. If you run a front desk and you're tired of software that fights you, we built this for you.
